title: SignalFire State of Talent Report 2026
takeaway: AI/ML engineer share is up 39% since ChatGPT launched; forward-deployed engineers (+30%) are the fastest-growing customer-facing engineering role — the people who help companies buy, onboard, and actually use AI.

title: State of Forward Deployed Engineering 2026 (survey of 1,500 FDEs)
takeaway: Survey spanning Anthropic, OpenAI, Palantir, Scale, Databricks, Sierra, Harvey, Glean and 140+ growth-stage companies. Defines the role's day-to-day and career paths; frontier-lab senior FDE median total comp reported at $485k.

title: 2026 FDE Hiring Trends: What 1,000 Job Posts Reveal
takeaway: FDE postings grew ~800%; the industry's bottleneck has moved from modeling to deployment. The scarce skill is wiring models into real, often regulated, workflows — job descriptions are the leading indicator.

title: Forward-Deployed Engineers: How Demand Grew 10x in 18 Months
takeaway: FDE roles grew ~1,165% year over year. Useful hiring-side view of what companies screen for: customer-facing range plus the ability to ship integrations solo.

title: Plank FDE job market tracker (1,200+ live FDE roles)
takeaway: Continuously updated index of live forward-deployed engineer openings — both a market barometer and a direct source the radar routine checks each run.
